messages:
Alex: Pushed traces from the 8xA100 run where we hit the comm/compute overlap failure during CUDA graph replay. Repro ~60% with 64-token prompts. Link: https://perf.redwood/reports/1891234567

Priya: grabbing the traces now. did you enable the sm-sync fallback?

Alex: yes — fallback path triggered that serializes stream ordering. after that one replica got stuck waiting inside allreduce. not sure why the wait never finishes.

Jin: I pulled the capture logs. Looks like graph_replay stream (s2) records an event that s0 waits on. But during replay the event isn't visible to s0 in some runs, so ncclGroupStart hangs. snippet: 

```
[0x3] cudaStreamWaitEvent(s0, ev_123, 0) -- returning after event
graph_replay: cudaEventRecord(ev_123, s2)
graph_replay: cudaGraphLaunch(g_45) -> blocks until s2 progress
allreduce: ncclGroupStart() -> hangs
```

Marco: so cross-stream event recorded inside the graph capture isn't being handled by the driver the same way outside capture. kernel selection changed fwiw — we moved to fused_kernel_v2 in the selector last week.

Priya: note: KV cache prefetch uses async stream s1 and records events. If prefetch gets captured into the graph, the captured event timeline looks different on replay. suspect interplay between kv prefetch events + graph capture + fallback.

perf-bot: Analysis: "Cross-stream event recorded inside CUDA graph capture leads to event not visible to external stream wait on some driver versions (470.x, 510.x). Repro trigger: graph capture + event-based prefetch + NCCL allreduce launched on separate stream. Suggested mitigations: avoid cross-stream waits on events recorded inside graph capture; co-locate NCCL launches with graph stream; or use host-side sync around replay."

Alex: tests: with FLAG_CUDA_GRAPH_PREFETCH=0 and fallback off -> no hang. With fallback on + prefetch on -> hang reproduces. So fallback ordering is interacting with prefetch+graph capture.

Jin: can someone dump the kernel list for the trace? need to confirm whether fused_kernel_v2 introduced blocking behavior inside the graph.

Alex: kernel list from the run:
```
kernel_list:
  conv_fwd_fast (s2) selected: fused_kernel_v2
  kv_prefetch_async (s1) -> records event ev_p1
  attention_kv_cache (s2) -> cudaGraph capture includes it
  allreduce_nccl (s0) -> launch on stream 0 with stream wait on ev_p1
```

Marco: fused_kernel_v2 uses heavier shared memory and stalls some warps, but shouldn't make events invisible. however inside graph replay the entire graph could be serialized by the runtime which might change the visibility semantics.

Priya: I repro on driver 510.47 and 470.142 on our CI boxes. both hang. Can someone try 525 in a quick run?

Alex: workaround we tried: move NCCL allreduce to same stream as graph_replay (s2) -> no hang but latency regresses and nginx timeouts spike. not acceptable for production.

Jin: Proposal options:
- Change fallback: avoid serializing graph capture streams when KV prefetch events are present. Instead do a host-side cudaStreamSynchronize around replay before launching NCCL.
- Adjust kernel selector: when graph capture will be used, prefer capture-friendly kernels (that don't record external events) though might lose perf.
- Engineer a small repro harness that toggles prefetch inclusion in capture to get minimal reproducer for driver team.

Marco: I prefer repro-first approach. if driver bug, we'd escalate. If it's our capture ordering, we can patch fallback fast.

Priya: next steps: 1) Alex will add NVTX boundaries to graph capture and re-run with verbose cuda tracing. 2) Jin will add assert in fallback that detects recorded events external to the capture and log full event handles. 3) Marco will prepare a kernel-selection run toggling fused_kernel_v1/v2 under capture.

Alex: I'll open PR with the assert + opt-in fallback change: if external-recorded-events detected, fallback will do host-sync instead of stream-serializing and will log capture metadata. PR will include reproducer instructions.

deploy-bot: perf-test job queued: jobs/1891234590

Marco: thanks. @Priya please try driver 525 when CI slot frees.

Priya: will do, posting results in this thread. :thumbsup:
